exposure: anomalies of atrioventricular junctions and valves
ACHD subtypes (anomalies of atrioventricular junctions and valves, complex anomalies of atrioventricular connections, etc.)
cohort: 2114 women with ACHD who gave birth in hospitals in Canada (excluding Quebec) between fiscal years 2001-2002 and 2014-2015
finding: Women with different subtypes of ACHD are not uniformly at risk for adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: While this study found that mode of delivery was a factor considered in their analysis of pregnancy outcomes for women with adult congenital heart disease, it did not specifically report findings related to mode of delivery.
